# H — SOURCE-CONDITIONED HISTORICAL CO-UPDATE — META-380

**Issue:** Linear META-380 · **Preregistration:** `5ccb7ff6dd7a59a276aa3d6aa372f3df3bf1505d` (binding) · **Pre-outcome freeze:** `04557b2e3f33636e53fbfc5d7bd857315960083f`

`H` scores each candidate `t` in `Suite(T0)` by
`sum over s in S(T) of support_{<T}(s, t)`, where `support` counts eligible
transactions in the first-parent ancestry of `T0` inclusive that touched both
`s` (SOURCE) and `t` (TEST). Ties break on ascending lexical path, which carries
no popularity or structural information.

No decay, no normalization, no confidence, no lift, no learned weight, no
semantic inference, no author or commit-purpose feature. `H` abstains when no
candidate reaches `score_H >= 1`.

Invariants I3 and I7 confirm `T` contributes exactly zero to its own features
(PASS / PASS). Red test RT1 confirms non-inertness:
folding `T` before ranking changes 21 of 200 rankings.

The `H-MAX` aggregation sensitivity (§13) is reported below as the only
preregistered secondary.
